name: Líšnice (Šumperk District, Czechia)
description: Two horizontal stripes of navy blue and yellow in the ratio 5:3, with a yellow six-pointed star in the blue at the hoist.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 14 June 2000 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
